bench.rule: S032 §3 -- complete-session timing is not a promotion benchmark

claim_boundary: A complete 48-layer stateful Flash forward accepted one tokenizer-bound reference candidate token in one native process. Cross-species seams still use host diagnostic vectors; this does not prove repeated decode, source-independent NX, TPS, EBPW, capability, or HCLI residency.

execution.reference_contract: each caller-supplied continuation token is independently compared with the terminal argmax of its preceding exact 48-layer state
execution.state_reset_scope: linear species reset only before session token zero; full-attention KV buffers allocated once per layer and indexed by the advancing token position

next: Supply one more terminal-derived reference token with --prompt-length fixed at the original prompt boundary, then rerun the same persistent session.
